name: Textured Light Integration
definition: Extends the method to handle textured lights (e.g., stained-glass windows) by rectifying the light texture map $T(\alpha, \gamma)$ and multiplying it into the integrand.
summary: Textured Light Integration simulates spatially varying light sources by incorporating a rectified light texture into Min-Max Mipmap Traversal, requiring precomputed prefix sums of the product of light transport and texture intensity.
